title: Four-Corner Passing
description: A simple continuous passing pattern in a square that warms the group up while building accurate passes, pass-and-move habits and communication.

content.objective: Pass accurately and move immediately after the pass, keeping the ball moving around the square at a steady rhythm.
content.setup: Four cones mark a square about six metres wide. A line of players stands at each corner. The first player in one corner starts with a ball.
instructions: The first player passes to the player at the next corner and follows their pass to that corner.
The receiver catches with hands ready, steps into the pass and passes to the next corner.
Continue clockwise for one minute, then change direction and pass counter-clockwise.
Add a second ball starting from the opposite corner once the pattern is smooth.
Finish with bounce passes and overhead passes for variety.
coachingPoints: Show a target with the hands and step into the pass.
Pass and then move: do not stand and watch the pass.
Communicate: call the name of the receiver before passing.
Snap the wrists and finish the pass with the thumbs pointing down.
commonMistakes: Passing at the feet or too high.
Watching the ball rather than the receiver.
content.safety: Keep the passing lanes clear of stray balls and other groups.
progressions: Use a second ball, then add a required fake before each pass.
regressions: Use a single ball and pass only chest passes at a slower pace.
variations: Pass with the left hand only for a round.
